name: What's the difference between a drain snake and hydro-jetting?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a drain snake and hydro-jetting?

acceptedAnswer.text: A drain snake (or auger) is a flexible cable with an attached cutter that plumbers insert into a drain to break up or retrieve a specific blockage. It's effective for localized clogs. Hydro-jetting uses a high-pressure stream of water to thoroughly clean the entire interior of a pipe, removing not just blockages but also accumulated grease, mineral deposits, and other residues, leaving pipes almost like new.
acceptedAnswer.description: A drain snake breaks up or retrieves specific clogs, while hydro-jetting uses high-pressure water to thoroughly clean the entire pipe, removing blockages and residue.
